lines.say: Zoho CRM to Chat G P T? Five ways, not one.
lines.show: Zoho CRM to ChatGPT? Five ways, not one.

lines.say: Two bring CRM data into Chat G P T. Three bring Open A-I into Zoho.
lines.show: Two bring CRM data into ChatGPT. Three bring OpenAI into Zoho.

lines.say: One, the Zoho CRM plugin. Install, sign in, ask about your deals.
lines.show: One: the Zoho CRM plugin. Install, sign in, ask about your deals.

lines.say: Two, a Zoho M C P server. You pick every tool it may use.

lines.say: Three, Open A-I inside Zeeya, for drafts and summaries in the CRM.

lines.say: Four, Zoho Flow. A new lead starts an A-I step, with no code.

lines.say: Five, a Deluge function. Your prompt, your fields, your checks.
lines.show: Five: a Deluge function. Your prompt, your fields, your checks.

lines.say: Whichever you choose, start read only. Confirm every change.
